text:
maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — QBR prep + MDF allocation for HW + marketplace integrations. Timeline: finalize allocations by EOD Wed. Need: partner scorecard updates, requested co-funding per partner, and a prioritized tier nomination list.

sam (Finance): Can we get a clean csv of last quarter's partner spend + influenced pipeline? I’ll model carryover and contingency.

leo (Solutions): I’ll pull partner adoption metrics and marketplace install numbers. Any custom SKUs for Luminary or Atlas infra partners? @maria

anya (Product): Product needs bandwidth to ship the integration by EOW — that's gating the marketing co-fund. Risk: on-prem validation might add 3 weeks.

maria (Partnerships): Proposed tier buckets: Strategic (top 6) / Growth / Marketplace-only. MDF split suggestion 60/25/15. Open to adjustments.

sam (Finance): 60/25/15 is tight on contingency. Recommend 50/30/20 so finance can hold a reserve. Also need a clear approval flow: AE signoff -> Partner Ops -> Finance -> VP for exceptions.

leo (Solutions): Agree with a reserve. For Strategic partners we need a joint GTM doc before QBR — playbook, co-sell motion, and integration SLAs.

maria (Partnerships): Can we lock these dates: tier nominations by Tue, MDF request forms submitted Wed EOD, deck ready Thu AM. Who owns the deck?

anya (Product): I’ll own deck narrative + product ask slides. @leo pls add adoption metrics and install screenshots. @sam pls add budget slide with the proposed split and contingency.

deploy-bot: Reminder: qbr-deck-v3.pdf uploaded to #partnerships at 1978123477

maria (Partnerships): Quick ask for HW Marketplace partners: propose a per-SKU co-fund cap of $50k unless partner brings >$500k ARR or a strategic commitment. Thoughts?

sam (Finance): Add the cap but allow exceptions with VP approval. Also we should track MDF burn rate per partner weekly and include a forecast tab in the tracker.

leo (Solutions): I’ll build the tracker and populate baseline metrics. Will share a sheet link once seeded: https://drive.redwood/partners/mdf-tracker (placeholder).

maria (Partnerships): Scorecard metrics we want in the QBR: integration ship rate, marketplace installs, closed-won influenced, pipeline motion. We need proposed weightings.

anya (Product): Proposed weights: influence 40%, pipeline 30%, installs 20%, enablement (playbooks/enablement sessions) 10%.

sam (Finance): That weighting looks reasonable to me.

maria (Partnerships): :thumbsup: OK moving to action items.

maria (Partnerships): Action items — please confirm ownership and ETA:
- leo (Solutions): populate tracker with installs + influence by Tue 10:00am
- sam (Finance): run budget scenarios and contingency plan by Wed 3:00pm
- anya (Product): draft product ask slides + risk slide by Wed EOD
- maria (Partnerships): compile tier nominations and MDF forms Wed EOD, assemble deck Thu AM

leo (Solutions): noted and will ping partners for missing metrics.

sam (Finance): will include a line item for VP exceptions and a cap approval step.

maria (Partnerships): Also — QBR review session scheduled Thu 11:00am PT, please block calendars.

anya (Product): acked.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — syncing again after tracker is live.
